scientific_stage: M2-A2 audit of whether the TPE search concentrated locally compatible solutions into one region
purpose: Test whether the apparent lack of consequential point ambiguity in M2-A/B could be an artifact of adaptive TPE concentration. Sample each final declared M1 parameter domain non-adaptively, score only against public I1, and compare any compatible samples geometrically with the existing TPE-compatible set.

provider_domains.ProviderA: phase3 base M1-v2 declared search bounds
provider_domains.ProviderB: phase3 base M1-v2 declared search bounds
provider_domains.ProviderC: phase3 ProviderC expanded M1-v2 declared search bounds

local_scoring.reason: Make LHS MSE directly comparable with the existing TPE search MSE without rerunning Optuna.

compatibility_rule.reference: existing provider-specific best M1-v2 search MSE from m2_a_all_candidates.csv
compatibility_rule.reason: Reuse the already frozen M2-A screening ceiling. Do not change the compatibility definition after seeing the non-adaptive sample.

geometry.normalization: unit cube in the declared provider search domain, using log coordinates for mean_service_time and cost_rate and linear service_cv
report: distance of each LHS compatible point to the nearest existing compatible TPE point
whether each compatible LHS point lies outside the existing compatible axis-aligned bounding box
union compatible spans and maximum pairwise distance
geometry.reason: Report geometric expansion continuously rather than introduce a post-hoc remote/not-remote threshold.

interpretation_guard: This audit can show that TPE missed remote public-I1-compatible regions if non-adaptive samples discover them. Failure to discover such regions in 48 LHS points per provider is evidence of concentration/small compatible volume, not a proof that no remote compatible region exists.
